Name: Cindersap Forest Compatibility Merged Patch
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Map Compatibility Project: Cindersap Forest[/b][/size][/center]
[center]I love mods, and I love new NPCs. That being said, not a lot of these mods play together nicely in the map department. And all the little misplaced tiles or weird spots bothered the heck out of me. So, I've done my best to make a compatibility patch, depending on SVE, that's entirely automated. It reads your mods and assigns appropriate patches. The plan is to add more compatibility if any cool new NPCs come out (since I originally just made this for myself), and move on to other sections of Stardew, ie. the Mountains/Backwoods, ect. Since I also made this for myself, I ended up adding little things to make the forest more home-y. Added lights, natural pathing, etc. These additions are all toggleable.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]It's been checked for routing NPC schedules and should be good to go though I'm sure there's some NPC out there that'll find a way to get stuck, anyways.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]This patch effects the following:[/center]
[center][spoiler][left][b]Ornithologist’s Guild + Rupnan Collection Remake[/b][/left]
[list]
[*]With both installed, the guild gets squeezed into the forest’s far-left corner, where it overlaps everything. It now sits east of Mirren’s house, just off the dirt road from the farm.[/*]
[*]A small footpath winds up to the door, the barrels nearby are moved out of the way, and a bush and wildflowers frame the path.[/*]
[*]The roof is only solid where there’s actually roof, so you don’t bump into thin air.[/*]
[*]On festival days, the old spot is cleaned up on the Flower Dance and Festival of Ice maps too.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Valko[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]His tent no longer sits on top of Mirren’s garden. It’s now tucked into the trees in the southeast corner, by the cliff above the beach, with worn grass and wildflowers around it.[/*]
[*]His solar panel, meditation and workout spots move with the tent, and so does his 12-heart event.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Mirren[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]Their yard and garden are back to normal once Valko’s tent is gone.[/*]
[*]Their front fence runs a little further, with evenly spaced posts and a bush and pine at the end to hide a warp caused by Valko.[/*]
[*]Bushes no longer grow through the fence, and a stray patch of grass in her garden is fixed.[/*]
[*]The plant pot beside her house is no longer cut in half.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Cape Stardew[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]Added a grass trail leads from the river through the deep forest to the hidden entrance.[/*]
[*]A signpost and lamppost stand in a small clearing right before you reach it.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Hat Mouse Lacey[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]A short grass path runs west from her house and joins the Cape trail.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Lampposts and lights[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]Nine lampposts line the forest paths, from the farm road down to the Cape entrance, and switch on at night.[/*]
[*]Juna and Eugene each reset the forest’s light list, which switches off lights from other mods. With either one installed, the list is rebuilt: SVE’s lamps, the Enchanted Grove, Lance’s lantern, Juna’s and Eugene’s lanterns, the guild’s lanterns, the new lampposts and Pelican Town Utilities’ lamppost.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Cropgenics (Fernando)[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]His garden is a neat plot on worn dirt, one crop per row, and it changes with the seasons.[/*]
[*]An off-color leaf tuft and some stray pixels on his house are cleaned up, and a pine stands behind it.[/*]
[*]With Rupnan, Xalathar waits outside the house instead of walking into its wall.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Eugene[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]His garden lamps show their lit bulbs at night.[/*]
[*]With Cropgenics, his lawn blends naturally into Fernando’s instead of ending in straight lines, and his lower lamppost is back.[/*]
[*]The extra lamppost by his garden and the rock blocking his bench are gone, so you can walk behind the bench again.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Aymeric[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]The trees and bushes around his house are back.[/*]
[*]His front fence reaches the house walls with proper corner posts, and a pine stands at each front corner.[/*]
[*]Leftover shadows from missing trees are cleaned up.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Blood Magic[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]The camp entrance blends into SVE’s forest.[/*]
[*]The bush beside it is whole again, there’s no grass growing on top of it, the ground around the pillar is smooth, and a stray half tree trunk is gone.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Gem Sea Shores[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]The cliff beside the beach ramp has a proper edge.[/*]
[*]The little island pine near Fernando’s has its top back.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Rupnan Collection Remake[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]The cherry tree on the forest’s left edge is no longer cut off at the bottom.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]Trolley Expansion[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]Trees no longer grow over the signpost or into the tunnel.[/*]
[*]Two bushes frame the tunnel without blocking it.[/*]
[/list][left][b][b]SVE[/b][/b][/left]
[list]
[*]Rough grass edges are smoothed out.[/*]
[*]A flickering double bush is fixed. [/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][b]For best results, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods/54968]Schedule Compatibility Patch[/url] to change NPC schedules so they match up with the new layout. Additionally fixes lots of modded NPCs at festivals and other locations overlapping eachother.[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b]If you find any bugs, weird looking spots, or NPCs walking on water - please let me know![/b][/center]

Downloads.Description: Removed references to multiple disallowed mods, worked around them (mostly).

Manifest.Name: (CP) Forest Compatibility Patch
Manifest.Description: Makes Cindersap Forest map mods fit together on Stardew Valley Expanded: moves Valko's tent out of Mirren's yard, gives the Ornithologist's Guild a real home when Rupnan Collection Remake is installed, adds a trail to Cape Stardew and lampposts, and smooths over the spots where Gem Sea Shores, Cropgenics, Eugene, Aymeric, Blood Magic, Trolley Expansion and others overlap.
Manifest.Author: aerinanxiety
